speakers.name: Dr. Jamal Watson
speakers.bio: Professor, award-winning journalist, and author whose work sits at the crossroads of higher education, civil rights, and American political history. Former executive editor of Diverse: Issues In Higher Education and professor of Strategic Communications at Trinity Washington University.

speakers.name: Dr. Melanie R. Hill
speakers.bio: Andrew W. Mellon Associate Professor of Global Racial Justice and Associate Professor of American Literature at Rutgers University, Newark. Her book Colored Women Sittin' on High (UNC Press) is endorsed by Alice Walker and Ruby Sales.
